regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Brighton is forecast for about 25". Solitude and Alta follow.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 25", 13" of it Saturday. Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow. Winter Storm Warning at Grand Targhee from Friday to Saturday.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 21". Palisades and Sugar Bowl follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Palisades Monday.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Bachelor is forecast for about 18", 13" of it Monday. Mt. Baker and Stevens Pass follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Mt. Baker Monday and Monday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 22". Whistler follows.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 19", 18" of it Saturday. Vail and Breckenridge follow. Winter Storm Warning at Steamboat from Friday to Sunday.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Jay Peak is forecast for about 14", 7" of it Saturday. Mont-Sainte-Anne and Stowe follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Jay Peak Saturday and Saturday night.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 12", 7" of it Monday. Revelstoke and RED Mountain follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whitewater Monday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 10", 5" of it Tuesday. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 12 to 24 inches Sunday night through Tuesday night.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Sun Peaks is forecast for about 7", 4" of it Monday. Big White and SilverStar follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Big White Monday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 10", 9" of it Wednesday. Taos follows.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
